english.title: Aid / abet a person to threaten with a blade / sharply pointed article on school premises / further education premises
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) aided, abetted, counselled or procured **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to have

(A)_[an article which had a blade or was sharply pointed, namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE..),]_
(B)_[a folding pocket knife which had a blade the cutting edge of which exceeded 7.62 centimetres or three inches]_

with

(C)_[him]_
(D)_[her]_

on

(E)_[school premises, namely **(..SPECIFY SCHOOL PREMISES..),]_
(F)_[further education premises, namely **(..SPECIFY FURTHER EDUCATION PREMISES..),]_

and unlawfully and intentionally threaten another person, namely **(..SPECIFY PERSON THREATENED..), with that

(G)_[article,]_
(H)_[pocket knife,]_

in such a way that a reasonable person who was exposed to the same threat would think that there was an immediate risk of physical harm to them
english.legislation: Contrary to section 139AA(1) and (6) of the Criminal Justice Act 1988 and section 8 of the Accessories and Abettors Act 1861.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
aided / abetted / counselled or procured another person
to have with him / her
on school premises / further education premises
an article which had a blade or was sharply pointed OR
a folding pocket knife which had a blade the cutting edge of which exceeded 7.62 centimetres or three inches OR
and unlawfully and intentionally threaten another person
with that article / pocket knife

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes:
(i) 'School premises' is defined in section 139AA(5) as land used for the purposes of a school, excluding any land occupied solely as a dwelling by a person employed at the school.
(ii) 'Further education premises' is defined in section 139AA(5) means land used solely for the purposes of an institution within the further education section or a 16-19 academy.
(iii) Section 139(2) states an 'article' has the same meaning as section 139. Section 139(2) and (3) defines an article as one with a blade or was sharply pointed or a folding pocket knife which had a blade the cutting edge of which exceeded 7.62 centimetres or three inches.
(iv) Section 139AA was amended to extend the offence to cover not only school premises, but also further education premises and insert an objective element into the offence; for offences committed before 6th April 2022 see H10674.

other.penalty:
Either way -
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 4 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2002; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 139AA(6)(a) and (10) of the Criminal Justice Act 1988 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

For minimum sentence for this offence see section 312 of the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
